audit_binding.guard: exact source/campaign;20 terminal local gates;2 clean equal 815-case JUnits;8 immutable formal case bindings;5 complete fresh manual/CLI cases and explicit stopped record

scan_method: Every ZIP member fully read, CRC checked and SHA256 hashed; every nonbinary UTF-8/UTF-16 text fully regex/structured-JSON scanned without prefix/sample truncation. ZIPs processed sequentially, one member in memory at a time; no extraction.
limitations: Explicit eight current 9e83 acceptance lab traces, their finalized case/review inputs, current acceptance references, and every settled current manual JSON/JSONL/log/Markdown/text/PNG file. Historical/publication payloads are excluded.
Inventory construction hashes exact bytes; scan/DOM/finalizer results are separate and initially pending.
Manual completion time is bounded by the latest saved completed journal capture before the recorded forced owned-process stop. No launcher exit0 is invented.
Binary images are hashed/accounted by the text scanner without OCR or a fresh pixel review.
No live database, browser, service, tests, renders or remote actions are performed by this saved-file audit.
Heuristics cannot certify arbitrary secret encodings or unsaved traffic.
Binary members are hashed without OCR; a complete text scan is not an all-browser-pixel review.
Nested JSON strings are decoded up to eight layers.
